description: Which languages should I localize into next?. Ranks 60 candidate languages for product localization beyond en ja zh es pt fr de ko hi ar, by CLDR speakers (L1+L2), GDP (PPP) reach, digital-marketplace reach, official-language countries and CLDR locale coverage. Also lists writing systems (ISO 15924) with Unicode 17.0 character counts, direction and speakers. Routes: /; /answer (have, limit, offset); /scripts (rtl, limit); /script/{code}. Paid $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /, /answer, /scripts, /script/{code}. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: next-languages
